title: Random Integer Generator
text: Generate integers randomly distributed in specified range, 1 output, {Set size} sets size; {Source of initial seed}, {Initial seed}, {Sample time}, {Samples per frame}, {Output data type} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Random integer output scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Set size
params.values: Set size 8 (default) | positive integer | row vector of positive integers

params.name: Source of initial seed
params.values: Source of initial seed Auto (default) | Parameter

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
